sourceAuthority.document: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sourceAuthority.scope: TABLECONTENT style-related target references are hard pointers. Border override flags identify the fields included by this generated vector; the all-flags-set control includes all six properties.

priorFailure: Three AC1032 role/retry assertions failed in the current and pre-change ASan executables. The final-style negative used a zero-length typed null, which the existing compatibility policy accepts; two cell-style positive retry vectors emitted border values with all overrides cleared and did not match the current bounded parser.
change: Generate non-null role violations and matching hard-pointer positive controls with the same target 0xE705. Inspect the actual generated handle stream to bind both raw role and target before parsing. Set all six border-override bits for the vector that carries all six fields. Improve failure diagnostics. No production parser behavior changed.

validation.normal: libdxfrw_persistent_manager_prefix_dispatch CTest: pass; adjacent generated R14 raw-retention selector: pass.
validation.asan: Fully instrumented library and libdxfrw_persistent_manager_prefix_dispatch CTest: pass.
validation.rollback: Three non-null wrong-role cases reject, clear parsed state, and succeed on corrected input using the same parser. Their generated body and handle graph are local synthetic controls.

limits: The reader continues its existing typed-null compatibility policy; cross-producer semantics of mismatched typed nulls remain unqualified.
These controls do not establish producer-authored AC1032 TABLECONTENT layouts, source graph closure, strict output, or native behavior.
